text:
sqlpipe is a lightweight command-line tool for exporting PostgreSQL tables to Amazon S3 as Parquet files. It connects directly to your database, reads tables (or the results of custom queries), and writes them out in columnar Parquet format optimized for analytics and downstream processing. Whether you're building a data lake, feeding a warehouse, or archiving snapshots, sqlpipe handles the plumbing so you don't have to write and maintain brittle export scripts.

Designed for both one-off syncs and scheduled pipelines, sqlpipe supports incremental updates, configurable partitioning, and schema-aware type mapping between Postgres and Parquet. It runs anywhere—your laptop, a CI job, or a cron task—with a single binary and no external dependencies. Point it at a table, give it a bucket, and let sqlpipe keep your data in sync.
